target: Rudnick-Sarnak n-level correlations as Type II instance

carrier_definition.objects: families or principal/cuspidal automorphic L-functions, especially GL(N)
carrier_definition.test_function: Schwartz f with restricted Fourier support in proved theorems
carrier_definition.closure: lim_{T->infty} Xi_RS(f;T)=0 for admissible f; full conjectural support remains open

RS_proved_restricted_support: Rudnick-Sarnak 1996 proves n-level GUE correlations for principal L-functions in restricted Fourier support; this is not the full unrestricted conjecture.
retained_nogos: does not claim full Rudnick-Sarnak conjecture solved
does not claim GRH or RH solved
does not conflate restricted-support theorems with unrestricted conjectures
